Drawing: Beautify mode steadies your hand and tapers ink like a real pen.
Lines, circles, ellipses, triangles and boxes snap to clean shapes. Hold still to snap any sketch.
Undo after a snap brings back the stroke you drew.
Canvas: Align selected items left, center, right, top, middle or bottom.
Space three or more items evenly, or tidy a selection into neat rows.
Pasted and dropped images appear at once, with upload progress.
Round an image's corners with four presets that survive resizing and export.
Touch: Two fingers pan and zoom with any tool. One finger uses the tool.
Starting a pinch never leaves a stray stroke, erasure or note.
On phones, every tool fits on one toolbar row and the bars stack without overlapping.
Bars keep clear of the notch and home indicator. The menu scrolls on short screens.
Sharing: Invite link previews show the board's name and who sent it.
Voice: See how many people are in a call before you join or open a board.
Join muted, see who is speaking, and keep mic and hang-up controls in the toolbar.
Sound cues for joining, leaving and muting.
Keyboard: Shortcuts for align, space and tidy up: ⌥A/H/D, ⌥W/V/S, ⌥⇧H/V and ⌥⇧T.
Fixed the Bold and Underline row in the shortcuts list on Windows.
Agents: Removed the in-app Connect AI links and remote MCP endpoints. Agents use the local MCP server.
App: What's new shows the latest release notes, with this changelog one click away.

Text: Fonts preview on the selected text as you browse the font picker.
Typing reaches collaborators keystroke by keystroke.
Text size controls stay put while you resize, and the toolbar glides into place.
Fixed double-click creating a stray text box instead of editing.
Drawing: Set pen and eraser size in one-pixel steps, by Shift-drag or by Shift-scroll.
A ruler shows the brush size while you change it.
The eraser removes only the ink under the brush. Whole-stroke mode is one tap away.
Others watch your pen strokes appear as you draw them.
Boards: All boards screen: live now, recent, shared with you and everything you own, with search.
Views save named spots on a board. Jump with the arrows, { }, or ⌥1–9.
Views name themselves from what's in frame.
Export to PNG, PDF, SVG, a Markdown outline or a re-importable board file.
Every visit starts on a blank board that is saved once you add something.
A loading screen replaces the empty-board flash when switching boards.
The URL stays clean until you work on a board.
Sharing: One People list shows who you invited and when they were last here.
Removing someone retires their link, so they can't rejoin.
Following frames what the presenter is working on. Exact mode mirrors their screen.
A glowing edge and a Back button lead you to the presenter when the action is elsewhere.
Pick a collaborator by name to follow, and see who is working in each view.
Invited guests find their name already filled in on the join screen.
Profiles take a preset avatar or a photo.
Link previews show a share card.
Banners and tooltips stay clear of the corner bars.
Voice: Voice chat between browsers, with speaking rings on avatars and sound bars on cursors.
The owner or presenter can mute anyone or everyone, or turn on Stage mode.
Switch microphone or speaker mid-call, with a level meter.
Chimes play when people join or leave.
Keyboard: Pan with ⌘-drag on Mac and Ctrl-drag on Windows and Linux.
Shortcut labels show Ctrl, Alt and Shift on Windows and Linux.
p stays bound to the pen in Vim mode.
Accounts: Optional accounts with a passkey or email. Boards made in the browser move into the account.
A Save button and a reminder before you leave an unsaved board.
Collaborating needs only a screen name.
Hosted mode for running Brainboard on a public domain.
Agents: Connect AI linked ChatGPT, Claude and Codex over HTTP (removed in 0.4.0).
App: The empty board no longer shows made-up collaborators.

title: Collaboration, agents and Vim keys
highlights: Invite people with links that can edit or only view. See their cursors, selections and typing live, follow anyone, or present to the room.
AI agents can list, read, render and edit boards through a built-in MCP server. Their edits appear live in your tab.
Drive the board from the keyboard with a : command line, / search and an optional Vim mode.

Sharing: Invite links that can edit or view. Change or revoke them at any time.
Named cursors, selections and typing markers for everyone on the board.
Follow anyone from their avatar. Present makes everyone follow you, with an optional view lock.
Pause editing for guests or hide viewers' cursors.
Undo reverts only your own edits.
npm run share serves the board on your local network.
Boards: Boards are saved as files in ~/.brainboard and sync live between tabs.
Multiple boards with a switcher, rename and trash.
Agents: MCP server with tools to list, read, render, add, update and delete.
Agents get readable outlines, and their flow charts are laid out automatically.
Keyboard: A : command line with completion and history, and / incremental search.
Always-on Vim keys for undo, yank, marks, zoom and moving between items and boards.
Vim mode adds hjkl moves, insert, open, delete and put.
Commands for boards, find and replace, color, shape, zoom, theme, follow and present.
App: Black-and-white look with Geist type and a new logo. Color is kept where it carries meaning.
A first-run tour you can replay from the menu.

title: The first whiteboard
highlights: A near-infinite canvas for images, sticky notes, text, pen sketches and flow charts, saved in your browser.

Canvas: Pan and zoom a near-infinite canvas.
Bubble, box and decision shapes joined by curved connectors.
Drawing: A smoothed pen and an eraser.
Boards: Boards are saved in the browser, with JSON export and import.
